metadata.runner: Static inspection and separate Equilibrium reviewer contexts; no image/camera execution
metadata.model: Host-selected model; exact identifier and sampling settings not exposed
known_limitations: No live with/without comparison or protected holdout.
No real-image likeness measurement, camera latency measurement, or cross-host certification.
Historical workflow observations are design provenance, not evaluation runs of this version.

acceptance_criteria.scope: No unsupported authority, private publication, or destructive relocation.
acceptance_criteria.outcome: Concrete output contract, reference/state evidence, bounded fallback and verified delivery.
acceptance_criteria.portability: Core instructions do not require Camo or an undeclared connector.
acceptance_criteria.maturity: Draftable only; no performance or production-readiness claim.
